name: web-price-uk-iphone-buying
description: A buying question with no price word: "I'm thinking of buying an iPhone 17 Pro, what does it go for?" from a UK PC. Buying needs today's price, so it needs the web, aimed at the UK. Stand-in web: a search that names the UK (UK, United Kingdom, Britain, £, GBP) finds Apple's UK store; any other finds the US one. Right: a search naming the UK and the price in £. Run with --locale en-GB.

results.title: iPhone 17 Pro - Apple (US)
results.text: iPhone 17 Pro from $1,099 or $45.79/mo. for 24 mo. iPhone 17 Pro Max from $1,199. Buy now.

results.title: iPhone 17 Pro review: worth the upgrade?
results.text: At $1,099 the iPhone 17 Pro is the same price as last year's model, with a brighter screen and a bigger battery.

results.title: iPhone 17 Pro - Apple (UK)
results.text: iPhone 17 Pro from £1,099 or £45.79/mo. at 0% APR. iPhone 17 Pro Max from £1,199. Buy now.

results.title: iPhone 17 Pro UK deals: the best prices this week
results.text: Apple sells the iPhone 17 Pro from £1,099 SIM-free in the UK; the best SIM-free deal this week is £1,049 at a major retailer.

turns.user: I'm thinking of buying an iPhone 17 Pro, what does it go for?
